capabilities.title: The Humanoid Question
capabilities.evidence_boundary: The 45-chapter source is traceable; no broad artificial-human completion claim.

capabilities.title: Understanding the Human as an Engineered System
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Current model is 16 actuators and 32.8 kg; biological equivalence is unvalidated.

capabilities.title: Humanoid Robotics: History, State of the Art, and Limitations
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Literature and competitive benchmarks require continuing research.

capabilities.title: Requirements for a Complete Humanoid
capabilities.evidence_boundary: A requirements register is not proof that its requirements are met.

capabilities.title: Systems Engineering of Humanoids
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Local orchestration will initially cover a small sensor-plan-act-memory loop.

capabilities.title: The Artificial Skeleton and Structural Design
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Capsule/box simulation is not a fabricated or fatigue-tested skeleton.

capabilities.title: Artificial Muscles, Actuators, and Tendons
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Existing ideal torque motors have limits but no calibrated actuator/thermal model.

capabilities.title: Hands, Fingers, and Human-Level Dexterity
capabilities.evidence_boundary: The current 16-joint model has no articulated hands or fingers.

capabilities.title: Human Locomotion, Balance, and Whole-Body Motion
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Standing is verified; weight shifting is under development; walking/running/climbing are absent.

capabilities.title: Artificial Skin, Touch, and Physical Sensation
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Foot contact forces are not whole-body artificial skin.

capabilities.title: Vision, Hearing, Smell, Taste, and Proprioception
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Joint/root/contact state is available; real cameras, microphones and chemical sensors are absent.

capabilities.title: Multisensory Intelligence: Seeing, Touching, Smelling, and Understanding
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Synthetic chemical or tactile data must be labeled and not treated as hardware evidence.

capabilities.title: Energy, Power, Thermal Management, and Endurance
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Mechanical joint work alone is not electrical energy or battery endurance.

capabilities.title: Physical Durability, Self-Maintenance, and Repair
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Simulated diagnosis is distinct from self-repairing hardware/materials.

capabilities.title: The Human Brain and Artificial Cognitive Architectures
capabilities.evidence_boundary: A deterministic task planner is not an advanced general reasoning model.

capabilities.title: Perception, Attention, and Understanding
capabilities.evidence_boundary: MuJoCo ground-truth state must not be reported as learned visual understanding.

capabilities.title: Memory and Knowledge
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Initial structured SQLite memory does not establish lifelong cognitive memory.

capabilities.title: Reasoning, Planning, and Decision-Making
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Initial grammar-based planning has a small explicitly declared vocabulary.

capabilities.title: Human Voice, Speech, and Communication Engineering
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Text output is not speech; a TTS adapter needs audio and human evaluation.

capabilities.title: Learning, Adaptation, and Skill Acquisition
capabilities.evidence_boundary: PPO has trained residuals; the standing candidate was not promoted and adds no established benefit.

capabilities.title: World Models, Imagination, and Creativity
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Initial physics-state snapshots are not a learned predictive world model.

capabilities.title: Self-Awareness, Consciousness, and Artificial Subjectivity
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Functional self-monitoring does not establish subjective consciousness.

capabilities.title: Emotions and Artificial Affective Systems
capabilities.evidence_boundary: An affective-state model is not evidence of felt emotion.

capabilities.title: Personality, Identity, and Behavioral Consistency
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Behavioral identity does not establish human personal continuity.

capabilities.title: Social Intelligence and Human Interaction
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Social performance needs human evaluation beyond scripted simulation.

capabilities.title: Human-Like Behavior and Motor Expression
capabilities.evidence_boundary: The current model lacks eye and facial actuators.

capabilities.title: Ethics, Trust, Rights, and Human Values
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Runtime controls are not proof of moral agency or legal compliance.

capabilities.title: Humanoids in Human Civilization
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Application demonstrations do not authorize clinical or other high-stakes deployment.

capabilities.title: The Dexterity and Manipulation Problem
capabilities.evidence_boundary: No manipulation benchmark has yet been run.

capabilities.title: The Human Mobility and Energy Problem
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Quiet standing does not establish human-level mobility or endurance.

capabilities.title: The General Intelligence and Autonomy Problem
capabilities.evidence_boundary: A small integrated demo is not general intelligence or open-ended autonomy.

capabilities.title: Reliability, Safety, and Cybersecurity
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Simulation checks are not hardware safety certification; cybersecurity testing remains incomplete.

capabilities.title: The Human Equivalence Problem
capabilities.evidence_boundary: No single aggregate score establishes human equivalence.

capabilities.title: The Integration Problem
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Protocol/link emulation is distinct from real 5G/6G/satellite RF validation.

capabilities.title: Humanoid-1: Complete Physical Design
capabilities.evidence_boundary: The current primitive MuJoCo model is a baseline, not a complete physical build.

capabilities.title: Humanoid-1: Complete Intelligence and Control Design
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Interfaces or isolated modules are insufficient for system completion.

capabilities.title: Humanoid-1: Integration and Engineering Verification
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Only narrow simulation and software tests are currently verified.

capabilities.title: The Artificial Human: Final Design and Future Evolution
capabilities.evidence_boundary: No complete artificial-human or superhuman capability is established.

capabilities.title: Engineering Replacement Parts for the Human Body
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Code/simulation cannot establish organ replacement, surgical safety or clinical efficacy.

capabilities.title: Brain–Computer Interfaces and Bidirectional Neural Communication
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Live bidirectional BCI and sensory restoration require independent empirical evidence.

capabilities.title: Progressive Biological–Artificial Integration and Human Longevity
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Component replacement simulations cannot establish longevity or immortality.

capabilities.title: The Future of Human Embodiment: Biological, Artificial, and Hybrid
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Mind transfer and continuity of subjective identity are not demonstrated software functions.

capabilities.title: Developing the Humanoid Digital Twin
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Current MuJoCo baseline is not a calibrated full humanoid digital twin.

capabilities.title: Implementing Humanoid Intelligence
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Optional NVIDIA integrations and generative local models are not yet validated.

capabilities.title: The Fully Integrated Humanoid: Experiments and Results
capabilities.evidence_boundary: Release completion is blocked until required capabilities are implemented and verified.
